subject: Record of the Year vs. Song of the Year
query: what is the difference between record of the year and song of the year
title: What is the difference between Record of the Year and Song of the Year?
answer: Record of the Year honors a specific recording, so it goes to the artist, producers, engineers, mixers and mastering engineers. Song of the Year honors the composition itself, so it goes to the songwriters. The same track can be nominated in both. The 2027 Grammy nominations will be announced on Monday, Nov. 16, 2026.
body:
According to the Recording Academy, Record of the Year recognizes "the best overall achievement" in a recording, including performance, production and engineering. Song of the Year recognizes "the best achievement in songwriting" and is open only to the songwriters of new material. A singer who did not write the song can win Record of the Year but not Song of the Year.

The 2027 Grammys cover music released from Aug. 31, 2025, to Aug. 28, 2026. First-round voting ran from Oct. 12 to Oct. 22, 2026, and final-round voting runs from Dec. 10, 2026, to Jan. 7, 2027. The ceremony will be held on Sunday, Feb. 7, 2027, at Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles and aired on ABC, Disney+ and Hulu.
in_the_news: The Recording Academy will announce the 2027 Grammy nominations, including Record and Song of the Year, on Nov. 16, 2026.

faq.q: Who wins Record of the Year?
faq.a: The artist plus the producers, engineers, mixers and mastering engineers of the recording.

faq.q: Who wins Song of the Year?
Can a song win both Record and Song of the Year?
faq.a: Yes. The two awards judge different things, the recording and the composition, so the same track can be nominated for and win both.

faq.q: When are the 2027 Grammy nominations announced?
faq.a: Monday, Nov. 16, 2026. The ceremony is Feb. 7, 2027.
